name: The Binding
summary: In the Undercity, Carendin Halgar puts an initiate's command of a succubus to the test. Pure Hearts draw the demon from the Twisting Nether into a ritual circle, where the warlock must master it through combat.

sections.title: A Test of Will
sections.body: In the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Forsaken warlocks learn to command demons. Summoning a succubus marks a hard passage in that training. A voidwalker depends on brute force, and an imp on lesser malice. A succubus can turn seductive and mental enchantments against its summoner. So Carendin Halgar requires each initiate to prove mind and magic unshakable before granting lasting dominion over such a demon.

sections.title: Subjugation in the Circle
sections.body: Pure Hearts gathered from innocent souls in the Wetlands and Silverpine Forest open a way to the Twisting Nether. The succubus appears in the binding circle and attacks at once, seeking to overpower or entrance the warlock. To claim mastery and summon it at will, the warlock must break its physical form and cast its essence back into the void.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The rite tests whether Forsaken warlocks can master a succubus. By summoning and defeating one in the Magic Quarter, a warlock proves its charms cannot sway them and gains the power to summon and command one in battle.

Carendin Halgar trains warlocks in the Undercity's Magic Quarter and oversees Forsaken spellcasters' training and trials. He tests their mental endurance and dark arts before entrusting them with more dangerous summoning rites.

faq.q: Why were pure hearts needed to summon the demon?
faq.answer: Pure Hearts gathered earlier draw a succubus through the summoning circle. They serve as irresistible bait that brings the demon into the mortal realm.

faq.q: Where does the summoning take place?
aliases: where do i summon the succubus
faq.answer: The summoning takes place in a ritual circle in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, near Carendin Halgar and the warlock mentors.

faq.q: Why does the succubus need to be slain?
faq.answer: The warlock must slay the succubus to subjugate it. Shattering its form in the circle bends its spirit to the warlock's will, so it returns as a thrall rather than a master.

faq.q: Are succubi dangerous to Undercity warlocks?
faq.answer: Yes. A succubus's charms have bound many strong minds, despite the Forsaken's resilience against fear and sleep. Carelessness in the ritual can bring death or enslavement.

angles.text: As a warlock, this rite marks a hard step in your dark path. It tests your power to master seductive mental forces and bind cunning demons from the Nether to your will.
As Forsaken, you use whatever dark tools are needed to secure survival and dominion in Lordaeron. Subjugating demons is a practical means to those ends.
